_comment: Session 9: the shared Google Sheet 'Breaking City — Game Data' (tabs Products, Classes, Questions, Players). apiUrl = the Apps Script web-app link (tools/sheets/README.md shows how to make it, 5 minutes). While apiUrl is empty the game uses the local data files and keeps accounts on this device only. refreshMinutes = how long content from the sheet is cached. syncSeconds = how often a signed-in player's progress is sent to the Players tab.
